featured business of the month: florida coffee festival!!

November 9, 2026 · 3 min read

  • mail club
  • featured business
  • coffee
  • orlando events

hi!

drum roll please! if you haven't already heard, november's featured business of the month is Florida Coffee Festival!!

when you open your mail in the first week of November, you will find an exclusive opportunity to attend Florida Coffee Fest! just use the promotion code in your snail mail to receive 20% off general admission tickets when you purchase them online! the event takes place on November 15th at Festival Park.

it is no secret that central florida is home to some of the best coffee this side of the Mississippi! Florida Coffee Festival is a yearly celebration of the remarkable individuals who make the central florida's coffee scene so special.

whether you are grabbing a quick cup of coffee, attending a local meet up, or performing a cover of Espresso by Sabrina Carpenter, these sacred spaces are the lifeforce behind central florida's creative movement. we are so thankful for all of the cafes who transform their spaces into places where community happens. now is your chance to celebrate them at Florida Coffee Festival!!

What to expect at this year's Florida Coffee Festival

Here is what you can expect at this year's Florida Coffee Festival on November 15th:

The third annual Florida Coffee Festival is back again at Festival Park! Each coffee booth will have a sample ready for you to taste your way through an incredible lineup of local coffee shops, roasters, matcha brands, and specialty beverage companies from across Florida and beyond. This event is curated for those chasing the perfect espresso, looking to discover a new matcha, or hunting for a locally crafted mug!

Come discover your next favorite coffee shop, meet the people behind your favorite brands, and celebrate the community that makes up Florida’s coffee scene!

Expect to enjoy:

  • Coffee and matcha samples from some of the best brands and cafés around.
  • Espressos, pour overs, cold brews, matcha lattes, and specialty drinks.
  • Interactive experiences, like coffee cuppings and goat cuddling.
  • Live competitions, including the Florida Latte Art Championship.
  • Live music, and local artist and chef pop-ups.
  • Exclusive merch and festival releases.

Source: Florida Coffee Festival on Eventbrite

Florida Coffee Festival | November 15th, 11:00am - 4:00pm | Festival Park, Orlando
Get tickets on Eventbrite · See it on our events calendar
